name: Aqara Temperature and Humidity Sensor T1 (EU)

matter.note: No CSA listing found. Retailers say it works with Matter via an Aqara hub; no Aqara page seen confirms it.

apple_home.note: Retailers say it reaches HomeKit once bound to an Aqara hub. The exact Aqara wording was not seen; the FAQ is a snippet only.

google_home.note: Only retailer listings say Google Home works.

alexa.note: Only retailer listings say Alexa works.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant docs seen name no Aqara T1 support. A generic Zigbee coordinator is not documented for it.

hubRequired.note: The FAQ's range figures refer to the Aqara hub; retailers say a hub is required. The explicit Aqara statement was not seen.

localControl.note: No page seen describes hub-local operation.

senses.note: It also measures air pressure (30–110 kPa), which the site does not list as a sensing type.

power.note: Aqara's EU product page was reported to say CR2450; the T1 specs page says CR2032.

summary: The Temperature and Humidity Sensor T1 (TH-S02D) is Aqara's current Zigbee 3.0 climate sensor. It reads temperature (±0.3 °C), humidity (±3%) and air pressure, and reports hourly unless values change sharply. It is for indoor use and runs on a CR2032 cell. An Aqara hub connects it to Apple Home.
caveats: Needs an Aqara hub; support for Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings is unconfirmed on Aqara pages seen.
